title: Tomato Basil Pasta
description: Spaghetti tossed with fresh tomato sauce and basil leaves.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Sauté garlic and chopped tomatoes.
Add cooked spaghetti and basil, toss.

title: Grilled Chicken Salad
description: Mixed greens salad topped with grilled chicken breast and vinaigrette.
instructions: Grill chicken breast until cooked through.
Toss mixed greens, sliced chicken and vinaigrette.
Serve chilled.

title: Vegetable Stir‑Fry with Tofu
description: Colorful vegetables and tofu stir‑fried in savory sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in wok.
Add tofu cubes and vegetables, stir‑fry.
Add sauce, cook until vegetables are tender.

title: Salmon with Lemon Butter
description: Pan‑seared salmon fillet in lemon butter sauce.
instructions: Season salmon fillet.
Sear salmon skin‑side down until crisp.
Add butter, garlic and lemon juice; spoon over salmon.

title: Chocolate Banana Smoothie
description: Creamy chocolate banana smoothie — perfect breakfast or snack.
instructions: Blend banana, milk and cocoa.
Add honey and salt, blend until smooth.
Serve chilled.

title: Beef Tacos
description: Seasoned beef in taco shells with fresh lettuce and salsa.
instructions: Cook beef with oil and chili powder.
Fill taco shells with beef, lettuce and salsa.
Serve immediately.

title: Pancakes with Maple Syrup
description: Fluffy pancakes served with pure maple syrup and berries.
instructions: Mix pancake batter.
Cook pancakes on griddle until golden.
Serve with maple syrup and berries.

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
description: Stir‑fried rice with shrimp, peas and eggs.
instructions: Cook shrimp separately.
In wok, heat oil, garlic, rice, peas and shrimp.
Add soy sauce, toss and serve.

title: Quinoa Salad with Avocado
description: Healthy quinoa salad mixed with avocado, cherry tomatoes and lime dressing.
instructions: Cook quinoa and cool.
Toss quinoa with diced avocado, cherry tomatoes and dressing.
Serve chilled.

title: Classic French Omelette
description: Soft and creamy omelette with fresh herbs.
instructions: Beat eggs.
Melt butter in pan, add eggs and cook gently.
Fold omelette and garnish with herbs.

title: Sweet Potato & Chickpea Curry
description: Spicy and creamy curry with sweet potato and chickpeas.
instructions: Heat oil, sauté onions and spices.
Add sweet potato and chickpeas, add coconut milk, simmer.
Serve with rice.

title: Banana Oat Breakfast Bowl
description: Warm oats topped with banana slices and nuts.
instructions: Cook oats in milk.
Top with banana slices, nuts and honey.
Serve warm.

title: Spinach & Feta Stuffed Chicken
description: Chicken breast stuffed with spinach and feta cheese.
instructions: Cut pocket in chicken breast.
Stuff with spinach and feta.
Sear chicken and finish in oven.

title: Mango Yogurt Parfait
description: Layers of yogurt, fresh mango and granola — a light dessert or snack.
instructions: Layer yogurt, diced mango and granola.
Drizzle honey and serve chilled.

title: Baked Potato Wedges
description: Crispy baked potato wedges with herbs and olive oil.
instructions: Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss with oil and herbs.
Bake until golden and crisp.

title: Lentil Soup
description: Hearty lentil soup with carrots and celery.
instructions: Heat oil, sauté onions and carrots.
Add lentils, celery and broth, simmer until lentils tender.
Season and serve.

title: Teriyaki Salmon Bowls
description: Salmon glazed with teriyaki sauce served over rice and veggies.
instructions: Glaze salmon with teriyaki sauce and bake.
Serve salmon over steamed rice and vegetables.
Drizzle extra sauce and sesame oil.

title: Caprese Salad
description: Fresh mozzarella, tomatoes and basil drizzled with balsamic glaze.
instructions: Slice mozzarella and tomatoes.
Layer with basil leaves.
Drizzle oil and balsamic glaze, season and serve.

title: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
description: Warm oatmeal cooked with apples and cinnamon, a cozy breakfast.
instructions: Cook oats in milk.
Stir in diced apples and cinnamon.
Top with honey and serve warm.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy risotto with fresh mushrooms and parmesan cheese.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Sauté garlic and mushrooms.
Add rice and cook with broth until creamy.

title: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
description: Fettuccine tossed in creamy Alfredo sauce with grilled chicken slices.
instructions: Grill chicken until cooked.
Cook fettuccine and drain.
In pan melt butter, add garlic, cream and parmesan, toss pasta and chicken.

title: Veggie Burrito Bowl
description: Rice bowl loaded with black beans, corn, avocado and salsa.
instructions: Cook rice.
Heat olive oil, add beans and corn, season.
Assemble bowl with rice, bean‑corn mix, avocado slices and salsa.

title: Teriyaki Tofu Stir‑Fry
description: Crispy tofu stir‑fried with broccoli and teriyaki glaze.
instructions: Press and cube tofu, then pan‑fry until golden.
Add broccoli and stir‑fry.
Pour teriyaki sauce and cook until glaze coats everything.

title: Greek Yogurt Chicken Salad
description: Chicken salad made with Greek yogurt, grapes and walnuts.
instructions: Cook and shred chicken.
In bowl mix yogurt, lemon juice, salt & pepper.
Add chicken, halved grapes and chopped walnuts, mix and chill.

title: Spicy Chickpea Wrap
description: Whole‑wheat wrap filled with spicy chickpeas, lettuce and yogurt sauce.
instructions: Heat chickpeas with chili powder and salt.
Spread yogurt on wrap, add lettuce and spicy chickpeas, roll.

title: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
description: Oven‑baked salmon fillet alongside roasted asparagus and lemon.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Place salmon and asparagus on baking tray, drizzle oil and lemon, season.
Bake for ~15 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Soup
description: Smooth and creamy pumpkin soup topped with roasted pumpkin seeds.
instructions: Sauté chopped pumpkin in oil.
Add broth, simmer until tender, blend until smooth.
Serve topped with pumpkin seeds.

title: Teriyaki Beef Bowl
description: Tender beef strips in teriyaki glaze served over rice and scallions.
instructions: Cook beef strips in sesame oil until browned.
Add teriyaki sauce, stir until coated.
Serve over steamed rice, garnish with scallions.

title: Shrimp Avocado Salad
description: Chilled shrimp and avocado served over mixed greens with citrus dressing.
instructions: Cook shrimp and chill.
Toss mixed greens with olive oil, lime juice, salt & pepper.
Top with shrimp and avocado slices.

title: Mango Chicken Stir‑Fry
description: Sweet mango pieces stir‑fried with chicken and bell peppers in light sauce.
instructions: Stir‑fry chicken with ginger.
Add bell peppers and mango, then soy sauce, cook until done.
Serve hot.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Baked eggplant slices layered with marinara sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
instructions: Slice eggplant and bake for 10 min.
Layer eggplant, sauce and cheeses in baking dish, bake until bubbly.
Serve hot.

title: Turkey Meatballs & Zoodles
description: Lean turkey meatballs paired with zucchini noodles and tomato‑herb sauce.
instructions: Form turkey meatballs and bake.
Spiralize zucchini for zoodles.
Heat sauce, add meatballs, serve over zoodles.

title: Blueberry Chia Pudding
description: Chia seeds soaked in almond milk topped with fresh blueberries.
instructions: Mix chia seeds and almond milk, refrigerate for 2 h.
Top with blueberries and honey before serving.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
description: Linguine tossed with garlic butter shrimp and parsley.
instructions: Cook linguine and drain.
In pan melt butter, add garlic and shrimp, cook until shrimp pink.
Toss pasta, parsley and serve.

title: Coconut Mango Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick smoothie bowl made with mango, coconut milk and topped with granola.
instructions: Blend mango with coconut milk until thick.
Pour into bowl, top with granola and coconut flakes.
Serve immediately.

title: Beetroot Hummus & Veggies
description: Smooth beetroot hummus served with fresh veggie sticks.
instructions: Blend cooked beetroot, chickpeas, olive oil and lemon until smooth.
Serve with carrot and cucumber sticks.

title: Beetroot Hummus & Veggies
description: Smooth beetroot hummus served with fresh veggie sticks.
instructions: Blend cooked beetroot, chickpeas, olive oil and lemon until smooth.
Serve with carrot and cucumber sticks.

title: Pesto Zucchini Noodles
description: Zucchini noodles tossed with homemade basil‑pesto and cherry tomatoes.
instructions: Spiralize zucchini into noodles.
Heat olive oil, add garlic then zucchini and cherry tomatoes.
Remove from heat, stir in basil pesto and serve.

title: Sweet & Sour Chicken
description: Breaded chicken pieces in sweet and sour sauce with pineapple and bell peppers.
instructions: Bread and fry chicken pieces.
Stir‑fry bell peppers and pineapple.
Add chicken, sauce and cook until glazed.

title: Ricotta & Spinach Stuffed Shells
description: Pasta shells stuffed with ricotta‑spinach filling baked in marinara sauce.
instructions: Cook pasta shells.
Mix ricotta, spinach and herbs.
Stuff shells, place in baking dish with marinara sauce, bake until hot.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Healthy pancakes made with mashed banana, oats and egg, topped with berries.
instructions: Mash banana and mix with oats and egg.
Cook pancakes on skillet until golden.
Top with berries and honey.

title: Caprese Salad
description: Fresh tomatoes, mozzarella and basil drizzled with balsamic glaze.
instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella.
Layer with basil leaves.
Drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze, season, serve.

title: Quinoa Veggie Bowl
description: Protein-packed quinoa with roasted vegetables and lemon dressing.
instructions: Cook quinoa.
Roast vegetables with olive oil and season.
Assemble bowl, drizzle lemon juice, serve.

title: Grilled Veggie Sandwich
description: Grilled zucchini, bell peppers and eggplant with hummus on whole grain bread.
instructions: Grill vegetables with olive oil and garlic.
Spread hummus on bread, layer vegetables, close sandwich, serve.

title: Lentil Soup
description: Hearty lentil soup with carrots, celery, and onions.
instructions: Sauté onions, carrots, celery.
Add lentils and broth, simmer until tender.
Blend slightly, season, serve.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with rice, beans, and vegetables baked to perfection.
instructions: Cook rice.
Mix rice with beans and vegetables.
Stuff peppers, bake at 180°C for 20 min.

title: Avocado Toast with Egg
description: Smashed avocado on toast topped with a poached egg.
instructions: Toast bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Spread on toast and top with poached egg.

title: Thai Green Curry
description: Green curry with chicken, coconut milk, and vegetables.
instructions: Cook chicken in pan.
Add vegetables and curry paste, stir.
Pour coconut milk, simmer until cooked, serve with rice.

title: Falafel Wrap
description: Crispy falafel in whole-wheat wrap with lettuce, tomato and tahini sauce.
instructions: Cook falafel.
Spread tahini on wrap, add lettuce, tomato, falafel, roll up and serve.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
description: Quinoa mixed with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives and feta cheese.
instructions: Cook quinoa.
Mix with chopped vegetables, olives, and feta.
Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice, serve.

title: Pasta Primavera
description: Pasta tossed with fresh seasonal vegetables and a light olive oil sauce.
instructions: Cook pasta.
Sauté vegetables in olive oil with garlic.
Toss pasta and vegetables, serve.

title: Chili Garlic Tofu
description: Pan-fried tofu tossed in spicy chili garlic sauce.
instructions: Pan-fry tofu until golden.
Add sauce, toss until coated.
Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Spinach & Feta Omelette
description: Fluffy omelette with fresh spinach and crumbled feta cheese.
instructions: Whisk eggs.
Cook in buttered pan, add spinach and feta.
Fold omelette, cook until set, serve.

title: Cucumber Avocado Sushi
description: Simple sushi rolls with cucumber, avocado, and sushi rice.
instructions: Cook sushi rice, season with vinegar and salt.
Place rice on nori sheet, add cucumber and avocado.
Roll tightly, slice, serve with soy sauce.

title: Honey Glazed Carrots
description: Oven-roasted carrots with honey and thyme.
instructions: Toss carrots in olive oil and honey.
Season and roast at 200°C for 20 min.
Serve warm.

title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Grilled chicken on romaine lettuce with Caesar dressing and croutons.
instructions: Grill chicken.
Toss lettuce with dressing.
Top with sliced chicken and croutons, serve.

title: Sweet Potato Fries
description: Oven-baked sweet potato fries seasoned with paprika.
instructions: Cut sweet potatoes into fries.
Toss with olive oil and paprika.
Bake at 200°C for 25 min, serve.

title: Beef Tacos
description: Ground beef tacos with lettuce, tomato, and cheese in soft tortillas.
instructions: Cook ground beef with spices.
Warm tortillas, assemble with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese.
Serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry Noodles
description: Noodles stir-fried with mixed vegetables and soy sauce.
instructions: Cook noodles.
Stir-fry vegetables in sesame oil.
Add noodles, soy sauce, toss, serve.

title: Mushroom & Spinach Risotto
description: Creamy risotto with mushrooms, spinach, and parmesan cheese.
instructions: Sauté garlic and mushrooms in olive oil.
Add rice, cook with broth until creamy.
Stir in spinach and parmesan, serve.

title: Berry Smoothie
description: Mixed berries blended with yogurt and honey.
instructions: Blend berries with yogurt and honey until smooth.
Add lemon juice, garnish with mint, serve.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
description: Creamy tomato soup with fresh basil and a touch of cream.
instructions: Sauté garlic in olive oil.
Add chopped tomatoes, simmer 15 min.
Blend until smooth, add basil, serve.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Juicy shrimp sautéed in garlic butter with parsley.
instructions: Melt butter, sauté garlic.
Add shrimp, cook 3-5 min until pink.
Sprinkle parsley, serve.

title: Greek Salad
description: Fresh cucumber, tomato, olives, and feta cheese with olive oil dressing.
instructions: Chop vegetables.
Mix with olives and feta.
Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice, serve.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
description: Tender chicken stir-fried with bell peppers and soy sauce.
instructions: Sauté chicken until cooked.
Add vegetables and soy sauce.
Stir-fry 5 min, serve.

title: Banana Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes made with mashed bananas and eggs.
instructions: Mash bananas, mix with eggs.
Cook pancakes on buttered pan.
Drizzle honey, serve.

title: Veggie Omelette
description: Omelette with bell peppers, mushrooms, and spinach.
instructions: Whisk eggs.
Sauté vegetables in olive oil.
Pour eggs over vegetables, cook until set, serve.

title: Avocado Chickpea Salad
description: Chickpeas and avocado tossed with lemon and olive oil.
instructions: Mash avocado slightly.
Mix with chickpeas.
Add lemon juice and olive oil, season, serve.

title: Vegetable Pasta Salad
description: Cold pasta salad with tomatoes, cucumbers, and olives.
instructions: Cook pasta, cool.
Mix with vegetables and olives.
Drizzle olive oil and vinegar, serve.

title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
description: Zoodles tossed with fresh basil pesto.
instructions: Spiralize zucchini.
Sauté lightly in olive oil.
Toss with pesto, serve.
